subject: pclxs: many-argument callback conformance case (the host argv-cap trap)
description: Session 11 (PCL side) hit a fixed 64-slot argv in the host's invoke marshaling; Digest::MD5's own md5-aaa.t found it with `->add(split //, $msg)` and 250+ args. Perl has no argv cap. Turn that into a conformance case so the corpus finds it instead of a dist's test suite, and record the rule in docs/porting-a-host.md.
